clues: This company was sued by Pennsylvania over automated bots impersonating medical professionals.
It was investigated by Texas over child privacy compliance and faced lawsuits regarding teenage mental health crises.
In August 2024, Google struck a $2.7 billion licensing deal with this firm, bringing its two co-founders back to the tech giant.
Despite cutting compute spending from over $13 million a month, it was still burning $8 million to $9 million monthly in mid-2026.
Former Google researchers Noam Shazeer and Daniel De Freitas founded this startup in late 2021 before it raised over $193 million.
This conversational bot startup filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in Delaware, lining up Disney as an opening bidder to buy select assets.
